summary.tldr: Creates a national strategy to address pollution from shipping container spills, with studies, reporting, and Indigenous collaboration.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Transport to develop and implement a national strategy on pollution caused by shipping container spills.
Requires Indigenous organisations to have a meaningful chance to help develop the strategy.
Requires an independent study of gaps in the current rules, salvage capacity, ship manifests, tracking lost containers, and a possible cleanup fund.
Requires the strategy to include measures to prevent spills, improve communication, create a joint spill response task force, and monitor and remove debris from lost containers.
Requires the strategy to fund research on polystyrene, microplastics, other plastics, and removal methods.
Requires a report on the strategy within one year, then yearly progress reports starting in the second year, and publication on the Department of Transport website.
summary.background: The bill adds a new part to the Marine Liability Act.
